description:
Retrieves the complete stored profile for a single monitored website—including cookie banner configuration, GTM Consent Mode v2 settings, attached legal policy Markdown documents, and ready-to-use HTML/GCM v2 embed snippets.

When to use vs. related tools: Call 'get_site' when inspecting a single known property in full detail. Call 'list_sites' to browse or filter across all properties.

Preconditions & side effects: 'siteId' must match an existing site ID or exact URL/hostname in the registry. Read-only lookup.

Returns: JSON object containing 'success: true', full 'site' object, and 'embed_code' (or 'success: false', 'error', 'help', and 'available_sites' when not found).

siteId.description: Registered site UUID (e.g. 'site_paperloo_sandbox') or exact registered site URL.

name: get_site

outputSchema.description: Full site record and embed snippets.

available_sites.description: Registered sites returned when siteId does not match.

items.description: Summary entry for a registered monitored website.

embed_code.description: Ready-to-paste HTML banner script and GCM v2 default snippet.

gcm_v2.description: Google Consent Mode v2 default 'denied' initialization call.

html.description: Async HTML script tag for the Paperloo consent banner.

error.description: Lookup error message when success is false.

help.description: Guidance hint for discovering valid siteId values.

site.description: Full monitored site record including consent banner, GTM, and policy documents.

audit.description: Most recent cached compliance audit summary attached to this site.

findings.description: Key compliance findings recorded during the scan.

grade.description: Compliance letter grade from the cached audit.

scanned_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the audit ran.

cookie_banner.description: Persisted cookie consent banner configuration for this site.

accent_color.description: Hexadecimal accent color for banner buttons and highlights.

auto_block_trackers.description: Whether non-essential trackers are blocked prior to consent.

banner_message.description: Body copy explaining cookie usage and consent options.

banner_title.description: Primary heading displayed on the banner.

categories.description: Consent categories exposed in the banner preference center.

enable_gcm_v2.description: Whether Google Consent Mode v2 synchronization is enabled.

position.description: Viewport anchor position of the consent banner.

theme.description: Visual theme preset applied to the banner.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last banner update.

documents.description: Legal policy documents attached to this site.

markdown.description: Full policy text formatted in Markdown.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the document was generated or updated.

word_count.description: Total word count of the Markdown body.

gtm.description: Google Tag Manager container binding and GCM v2 default states.

default_ad_personalization.description: Default GCM v2 state for ad_personalization.

default_ad_storage.description: Default GCM v2 state for ad_storage.

default_ad_user_data.description: Default GCM v2 state for ad_user_data.

default_analytics_storage.description: Default GCM v2 state for analytics_storage.

trigger_events.description: Whether consent changes emit 'paperloo_consent_update' events to dataLayer.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last GTM configuration update.

url.description: Primary HTTPS/HTTP URL of the property.

success.description: True if site was found; false if siteId did not match any registered site.

title: Get Full Monitored Site Details
